title: Collector Crypt provider adapter
goal: Clean-room client for the real Collector Crypt gacha API, with --dry-run support.
steps: Implement typed client functions for GET /api/machines, POST /api/generatePack, POST /api/openPack, GET /api/buyback/available, POST /api/buyback, POST /api/submitTransaction, GET /api/pack/status against https://gacha.collectorcrypt.com
Always send the x-api-key header on every call, including the GET endpoints that currently work without one
Add exponential-backoff retry and idempotency via the runner's existing requestDigest pattern
Add a --dry-run mode that performs only the real read-only calls and refuses to call any mutation endpoint
Record fixture HTTP responses for CI; add a separate, explicitly-labeled live-read-only smoke test (GET /api/status, /api/machines) that is non-blocking in CI
acceptance: Every documented mutation endpoint has a typed client function
x-api-key is sent on every request, GET included
A network failure triggers idempotent retry, never a duplicate mutation
notes: Reimplemented clean-room per product/SOURCE_BOUNDARY.md; the legacy canary branch's collector-crypt.js/collector-executor.js may inform technique only, never be copied.
